name: The Grand Betrayal
summary: High Tinker Mekkatorque asks you to strike at Mekgineer Thermaplugg, who betrayed him and the gnomish people. Thermaplugg's rule keeps the gnomes from reclaiming Gnomeregan.

sections.title: Mekkatorque's Appeal
sections.body: High Tinker Mekkatorque seeks your aid in Gnomeregan's struggle to return the city to gnomish control. He trusted Mekgineer Thermaplugg, but Thermaplugg betrayed him and the gnomish people. Now the gnomes are displaced, and Thermaplugg rules their home. Mekkatorque asks you to bring down the betrayer so their plans to reclaim the city can advance.

sections.title: The City’s Claim
sections.body: With Mekgineer Thermaplugg dead, Mekkatorque says the gnomes are a step closer to retaking Gnomeregan.

faq.answer: Mekgineer Thermaplugg betrayed High Tinker Mekkatorque and the gnomish people.
Mekkatorque says Thermaplugg's betrayal left the gnomes displaced from Gnomeregan, with Thermaplugg in charge.

faq.q: Who asks for help against Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: High Tinker Mekkatorque asks you to kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

faq.q: What does Mekkatorque want for Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Mekkatorque and the gnomes aim to return Gnomeregan to their control.

angles.text: As a gnome, Mekkatorque's call concerns your people's lost home and their fight to reclaim Gnomeregan.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Grand Betrayal
